finding.description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

sequence.description: I2 nonce freshness: attempt OIDC enterprise SSO login where the IdP omits nonce in id_token (mock IdP default). RP must reject. Include a separate password-login identity as control to ensure the tenant is functional and to satisfy multi-identity requirement.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: When an OIDC authorization request uses nonce, the RP must reject an id_token missing nonce (prevents replay/callback injection). If Logto accepts nonce-less id_tokens from enterprise OIDC SSO, freshness/anti-replay is violated.

finding.sequence_description: MFA coherence across auth paths: enable MFA for a user, then attempt enterprise SSO login for same email. If SSO login succeeds without MFA enforcement, alternate path skips required step.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_sso_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victim_sso_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Enterprise SSO login succeeded for an MFA-required user, indicating MFA step skipping via alternate binding path — flow coherence violated

sequence.description: MFA coherence across auth paths: enable MFA for a user, then attempt enterprise SSO login for same email. If SSO login succeeds without MFA enforcement, alternate path skips required step.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: When MFA is required for a principal, all authentication paths that establish a session for that principal must enforce the MFA step; SSO must not bypass MFA due to flow step-skipping.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Password login unexpectedly succeeded without MFA challenge despite MFA enabled; cannot evaluate SSO bypass hypothesis
